tools.name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tools.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings back to readable text. Supports UTF-8 and ASCII.

tools.name: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate UUID v4 (random) and UUID v7 (time-ordered) with bulk generation and copy-to-clipboard.

tools.name: Hash Generator
tools.description: Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and MD5 hashes from any text input using browser-native crypto.

tools.name: JSON Formatter & Validator
tools.description: Format, validate, and minify JSON. Beautify messy JSON with syntax highlighting and line numbers.

tools.name: JWT Decoder
tools.description: Decode JWT tokens without sending them to a server. Inspect header, payload, and signature parts.
